item.text: I confirmed this workspace root only contains the benchmark descriptor files, so I’ll answer from the project’s recorded MOOSEDev implementation notes you provided (which describe the current `get_relevant_context` behavior).

For a non-empty `topic`, `get_relevant_context` uses the symbolic retrieval path in the KG layer: it calls `relevant_context()`/`entity_index.search_classes(topic, limit)`, then converts matching entities to `ContextItem`s (no LLM involved), and applies the topic relevance floor (`TOPIC_RELEVANCE_FLOOR`, currently 0.45) before returning results.  
If a topic query yields no entries above that threshold, the tool reports `"No recorded knowledge relevant to \"{topic}\""` (as opposed to a generic empty-graph message), so topic-only misses do not imply the graph is empty.  

Source: recorded entries “get_relevant_context: pure-symbolic context retrieval via entity index (topic) or list-all (no topic)” and “get_relevant_context: relevance floor (0.45) drops noise hits; topic-aware empty-state is honest”.
